title: Nissan USA newsroom: 2016 LEAF press kit
notes: 2016 LEAF US press kit: S 24 kWh, 3.6 kW charger (6.6 optional in Charge Package, which adds the quick charge port); SV/SL 30 kWh, 6.6 kW standard, quick charge port standard; battery preconditioning not mentioned (cabin only via NissanConnect EV).
